UNSAFE USE: direct fixed-index descriptor reads at probe/bind/init (endpoint[k].desc.bEndpointAddress / .wMaxPacketSize) used to program pipes, and wMaxPacketSize used to compute and store per-altsetting max packet sizes (alt_max_pkt_size[]) that later size/limit URB transfer buffers. CONSEQUENCE: NULL-pointer dereference or out-of-bounds read of kernel memory triggered by mere device plug-in (local DoS, crash at probe; OOB-read values can propagate into buffers/logic, and mis-sized wMaxPacketSize-derived state can enable OOB access later). Transferable invariant: kernel code must validate an untrusted descriptor-declared length before using a device-model-assumed index into a descriptor array. The seed file cx231xx is a demonstration and never reportable; workers must find the same mechanism elsewhere.
